Act9-1#1.zh: 林冲棒胜洪教头，柴进愈加敬重，留众人在庄上歇息。此后柴进托人替林冲在沧州安排了看守草料场的差事，林冲谢过照应，前去交割。众好汉放心不下，仍在附近相护。另一边，陆谦正在沧州城中一家酒店盘算。
Act9-1#1.t: After Lin Chong beat Instructor Hong with the staff, Chai Jin respected him all the more and let everyone rest at the manor. Chai Jin then arranged through a friend for Lin Chong to guard the army fodder depot in Cangzhou. Lin Chong thanked him and went to take over the post. The heroes, still uneasy, stayed nearby to protect him. Meanwhile, Lu Qian was scheming in a tavern in Cangzhou.

Act9-1#2.zh: （林冲到了沧州，却有柴大官人照应，又有几位好汉相护。若再像野猪林那般强取，只怕仍要失手……）
Act9-1#2.t: (Lin Chong has reached Cangzhou, with Lord Chai looking after him and those heroes guarding him. If I try force again like at Wild Boar Forest, I'll probably fail again...)

Act9-1#3.zh: 陆虞候，别来无恙！太尉府的差事，可有着落了？
Act9-1#3.t: Captain Lu, how have you been! Any progress on the Marshal's business?

Act9-1#4.zh: 原来是富安。你从东京赶来，可是衙内又有吩咐？
Act9-1#4.t: So it's Fu An. You've come all the way from Kaifeng. Does the young master have new orders?

Act9-1#5.zh: 衙内一心要林冲的性命，催我来与你商议。此事若成，自有重赏。
Act9-1#5.t: The young master is set on having Lin Chong's life and sent me to plan with you. If it works, there'll be a big reward.

Act9-1#6.zh: 他到了沧州仍不得安生，太尉府还不肯放过他？
Act9-1#6.t: He's in Cangzhou and still can't be left in peace? The Marshal won't let him go?

Act9-1#7.zh: 太尉也要断了这条后患。林冲如今在何处落脚？
Act9-1#7.t: The Marshal wants this loose end cut too. Where is Lin Chong staying now?

Act9-1#8.zh: 先前在柴进庄上住过。柴家门第非比寻常，不可贸然闯庄拿人。
Act9-1#8.t: He stayed at Chai Jin's manor before. The Chai family is no ordinary house; we can't just storm in and arrest him.

Act9-1#9.zh: 柴大官人家传誓书铁券，确是动不得。总须另寻时机。
Act9-1#9.t: Lord Chai's family holds the iron charter of immunity; he really can't be touched. We'll have to find another chance.

Act9-1#10.zh: 林冲与我自幼相交，如今却因太尉府的差遣，落得这般田地……
Act9-1#10.t: Lin Chong and I have been friends since childhood, and now, on the Marshal's orders, he's come to this...

Act9-1#11.zh: 陆虞候莫再迟疑。我带来些人手，必要时可替我们把守道路。
Act9-1#11.t: Don't hesitate any more, Captain Lu. I've brought some men; they can guard the roads for us if need be.

Act9-1#12.zh: 事已至此，也顾不得旧日情分了。只须办得干净，休留下后患。
Act9-1#12.t: It's gone too far to worry about old friendship. We just need to do it cleanly and leave no loose ends.

Act9-1#13.zh: 先查清他眼下的差使，再作计较。
Act9-1#13.t: First find out what post he holds now, then we'll decide.

Act9-1#14.zh: 我正为此事踌躇：他若仍在柴庄，有人护着，实不好下手。
Act9-1#14.t: That's just what's troubling me: if he's still at the Chai manor with people protecting him, it's hard to strike.

Act9-1#15.zh: 我知道一件事：柴大官人托人安排林冲去看守草料场，如今人已经交割过去了。
Act9-1#15.t: I know something: Lord Chai arranged for Lin Chong to guard the fodder depot, and he's already taken over the post.

Act9-1#16.zh: 哦？此事当真？草料场离城远，可比柴家庄容易行事。
Act9-1#16.t: Oh? Is that so? The depot is far from town. Much easier than the Chai manor.

Act9-1#17.zh: 这差事不是我安排的，只是我恰好听得消息。那地方草堆连着仓廒，最怕的就是火烛。
Act9-1#17.t: I didn't arrange the post; I just happened to hear about it. The hay stacks there run right up to the granaries. Fire is what they fear most.

Act9-1#18.zh: 这位壮士是？为何也这般留意林冲？
Act9-1#18.t: And who are you? Why are you so interested in Lin Chong?

Act9-1#19.zh: 我便是洪教头。先前比棒败在他手里，心中不服；如今既遇着二位，也愿帮上一把。
Act9-1#19.t: I'm Instructor Hong. I lost to him in a staff bout and I'm not satisfied. Now that I've met you two, I'd be glad to lend a hand.

Act9-1#20.zh: 原来如此。既知道他在草料场，我们便从那里下手。
Act9-1#20.t: I see. Since we know he's at the fodder depot, that's where we'll strike.

Act9-1#21.zh: 若在草堆四下放起火来，便叫他无处容身。纵然侥幸逃出，失了大军草料，也难逃官司。
Act9-1#21.t: Set the hay stacks alight on every side and he'll have nowhere to hide. Even if he gets out by luck, losing the army's fodder will land him in court.

Act9-1#22.zh: 正是！再打点差拨，让他替我们遮掩。只等夜深无人时，便可动手。
Act9-1#22.t: Exactly! And we'll bribe the warder to cover for us. We just wait until late at night when no one's about, then act.

Act9-1#23.zh: 洪教头得知林冲看守草料场，陆谦、富安遂商议纵火害人。
Act9-1#23.t: Learning that Lin Chong guards the fodder depot from Instructor Hong, Lu Qian and Fu An plot to burn him out.
